params.script:
tell application "Safari"
    set readingItems to every reading list item
    set itemData to {}
    repeat with anItem in readingItems
        try
            set addedDate to date added of anItem
        on error
            set addedDate to date "Thursday, January 1, 1970 at 12:00:00 AM"
        end try
        set end of itemData to {addedDate, name of anItem, URL of anItem}
    end repeat
    set sortedItems to my sortByDateDescending(itemData)
    set outputText to ""
    set itemCount to 0
    repeat with entry in sortedItems
        if itemCount is less than 4 then
            set itemCount to itemCount + 1
            set outputText to outputText & itemCount & ". " & item 2 of entry & " — " & item 3 of entry & return
        end if
    end repeat
    return outputText
end tell

on sortByDateDescending(theList)
    repeat with i from 1 to (count of theList) - 1
        repeat with j from i + 1 to count of theList
            if item 1 of item j of theList is greater than item 1 of item i of theList then
                set temp to item i of theList
                set item i of theList to item j of theList
                set item j of theList to temp
            end if
        end repeat
    end repeat
    return theList
end sortByDateDescending

tell application "Safari"
	set itemsList to every reading list item
	set n to count of itemsList
	set startIndex to n - 3
	if startIndex < 1 then set startIndex to 1
	set output to ""
	repeat with i from n to startIndex by -1
		set itm to item i of itemsList
		try
			set itemTitle to name of itm
		on error
			set itemTitle to "(untitled)"
		end try
		try
			set itemURL to URL of itm
		on error
			set itemURL to ""
		end try
		set output to output & itemTitle & " — " & itemURL & linefeed
	end repeat
	return output
end tell
